title: wg: protocol-06 credential identity vs user URI unspecified
description: Suggestion. §3 Table 1 and §7.5 do not say how an MLS credential identity maps to a participant-list user (user URI vs client URI). Every room-policy check needs this mapping. mimid: BasicCredential identity = user URI (decision mimid-1wgh.6.1). Fix: state the mapping.
notes:
Verified 2026-10-18 vs -06/-09/-04 (= main): PARTLY. Implied user-URI equality in franking; §4.2 TODO acknowledges. New issue, merge with 37.70.

Filed 2026-10-18: https://github.com/ietf-wg-mimi/mimi-protocol/issues/150
Evidence 2026-10-18: with credential identity = user URI (mimid H1), stock mls-rs rejects a second leaf with the same BasicCredential, so multi-device users break interop; the spec should say whether credential identity names the user or the client.
